mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.room_id FROM voice_room_member m FORCE INDEX (idx_voice_expired_members) INNER JOIN voice_room r ON r.id=m.room_id WHERE m.member_state='ACTIVE' AND m.lease_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND m.room_id>#{after} AND r.control_mode='CONTROLLED' AND r.status='OPEN' ORDER BY m.room_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM voice_media_binding WHERE room_id=#{room} AND binding_state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM voice_media_binding WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE voice_media_binding SET session_id=#{binding.sessionId},generation=#{binding.generation},media_identity=#{binding.mediaIdentity},binding_state=#{binding.bindingState},publish_desired=#{binding.publishDesired},seat_no=#{binding.seatNo},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE room_id=#{binding.roomId} AND user_id=#{binding.userId} AND generation=#{old}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM voice_media_retirement FORCE INDEX(idx_voice_retire_expired) WHERE job_state='PROCESSING' AND attempts<10 AND lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY lease_until,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT * FROM voice_media_retirement FORCE INDEX(idx_voice_retire_due) WHERE job_state='PENDING' AND attempts<10 AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE voice_media_retirement SET job_state='PROCESSING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{token},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,40,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND attempts<10 AND ((job_state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (job_state='PROCESSING' AND lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))
UPDATE voice_media_retirement SET job_state='DEAD',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE job_state='PROCESSING' AND attempts=10 AND lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) LIMIT 100

UPDATE voice_media_retirement SET job_state='DONE',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND job_state='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE voice_media_retirement SET job_state='DEAD''PENDING',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delay},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND job_state='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voice_media_retirement WHERE room_id=#{room} AND job_state IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voice_media_retirement WHERE room_id=#{room} AND job_state='DEAD'
